content.comment_body: Hello, I am searching for a fuel level sensor that can interface with [product_name]. I need to monitor the fuel tank level in a heating system. Any suggestions or ideas?
You can use a Vega sensor, which works effectively with [product_name]. Models Vega 51 or Vega 71 could be suitable.
Thanks for sharing the document regarding the Hella fuel level sensor. It was very helpful for me.
